# Vendored: usd-recorder's replay writer

`replay_writer.hpp` is copied unchanged from
[usd-recorder](https://github.com/Preponderous-Software/usd-recorder) **v0.2.0**
(commit `7e67946af3fd9d57ab5a02eacc8f396c13c9a95b`),
`cpp/include/usd_recorder/replay_writer.hpp`, under the MIT licence in `LICENSE`.

It writes the `usd-replay/1` contract (usd-recorder's `docs/REPLAY.md`) as `.usda` with only the
standard library, so `mb_strata --record` needs no OpenUSD. To update it, copy the file from a newer
tag and change the version and commit above.
